text.p: NetManage Inc. on Tuesday said it will acquire NetSoft Inc., a privately held developer of computer communications software, for $26 million in cash.
Cupertino, Calif.-based NetManage, which makes products that connect computer networks, said the deal will create one of the largest vendors in the market for such products.
The deal will be accounted as a purchase and is expected to close in August.
NetSoft is based in Irvine, California.
NetManage's stock rose 12.5 cents to $3.44 on Nasdaq at midafternoon.
